# PDF Reading

```{r}
# read pdf into R
raw_pdf_text <- pdf_text("2025-select-fall-adrb-tables-2-0.pdf")

# extracting specific page for testing

page_37 <- raw_pdf_text[37]
cat(page_37)
```
Attempting to create a function for table extraction.
```{r}
target_pages <- 36:40

extract_adrb_table <- function(page_num, pdf_data) {
  # getting text for one page and splitting into lines
  lines <- pdf_data[page_num] |> read_lines()
  
  # reomving headers and footers
  clean_lines <- lines[!str_detect(lines, "ADRB|Page|Table 1-5C | School/")]
  
  # converting to tibble
  df <- tibble(raw_line = clean_lines) |> 
    # removing empty lines
    filter(raw_line != "") |> 
    # identifying major and counts
    mutate(
      major_name = str_extract(raw_line, "^[A-Za-z &,-/]+"),  # match beginning of line, all uppercase and lowercase, allow for a space, and allow symbols
      counts_raw = str_remove(raw_line, "^[A-Za-z &,-/]+")
    ) |> 
    # trimming whitespace
    mutate(across(everything(), str_squish)) |> 
    filter(!is.na(major_name), major_name != "Total")
  
  return(df)
}

```
Attempt at processing pages into a master list
```{r}
section_1_raw <- map_dfr(target_pages, extract_adrb_table, pdf_data = raw_pdf_text)
```

```{r}
tidy_section_1 <- section_1_raw |> 
  separate(counts_raw,
           into = paste0("v", 1:21),
           sep = "\\s+",
           convert = TRUE,
           fill = "right") |> 
  # pivot to long
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("v"),
               names_to = "column_pos",
               values_to = "count") |> 
  # extract a numeric position and assign a year/metric
  mutate(
    column_num = as.numeric(str_remove(column_pos, "v")),
    year = case_when(
      column_num <= 3  ~ 2019,
      column_num <= 6  ~ 2020, 
      column_num <= 9  ~ 2021,
      column_num <= 12 ~ 2022,
      column_num <= 15 ~ 2023, 
      column_num <= 18 ~ 2024,
      column_num <= 21 ~ 2025
    ),
    # Ensure metric repeats M1, M2, Total consistently
    metric = rep(c("M1", "M2", "Total"), length.out = n())
  ) |> 
  select(major_name, year, metric, count)
    
  
           

```
